content.name: Marcus Delgado
content.title: Senior FP&A Manager
content.summary: FP&A leader with 14 years in banking, consumer goods and freight logistics. Runs planning for a $1.1B transportation company, manages a team of five analysts, and built the driver-based forecast that held full-year EBITDA within 2% of plan through a volatile fuel market.

experience.title: Senior FP&A Manager
bullets: Lead a five-analyst team that owns the annual operating plan, quarterly reforecasts and board materials for a $1.1B carrier.
Designed a driver-based forecast linking lane volume, fuel surcharge and driver pay, keeping full-year EBITDA within 2% of plan for two straight years.
Moved planning from 40 linked workbooks to Anaplan, cutting the reforecast cycle from three weeks to eight days.
Partner with the COO on network decisions; a terminal consolidation case I modeled is saving $6.4M a year.

experience.title: FP&A Manager
bullets: Built monthly cost-per-mile reporting by terminal that operations leaders now review every Monday.
Led budgeting for $380M of linehaul and maintenance spend across 31 terminals.
Evaluated three tuck-in acquisitions; two closed, adding $95M in annual revenue at the multiples we modeled.
Hired and trained two analysts who were both promoted within 24 months.

experience.title: Senior Financial Analyst
bullets: Owned trade-spend analysis for a $420M snack portfolio and reallocated $11M from low-return promotions.
Built SKU-level margin waterfalls that led to the exit of 60 unprofitable items.
Prepared the monthly variance package for the CFO, explaining price, volume and mix drivers.

experience.title: Financial Analyst
bullets: Produced branch profitability reports for 48 branches and supported two branch closure decisions.
Maintained the deposit pricing model used by the ALCO committee each month.
Automated the monthly regulatory call-report tie-out, saving about 30 analyst hours per cycle.

education.school: DePaul University, Kellstadt Graduate School of Business

achievements.title: $6.4M annual savings
achievements.detail: Terminal consolidation business case approved by the board in 2024.
